_notes: Lesson copy for the restored season tutorials. The original scripted timed-profit mission is replaced by real-action progress and content/learning-check.json.

missions.title: Trade and inspect costs
missions.lesson: Sales realise trading gains or losses; performance dividends are another source of return. Profit is not required to learn execution.

missions.title: Read the spread
missions.lesson: Check the available bid and ask, fees and price impact. A limit controls the price but cannot guarantee a fill.

missions.title: Diversify
missions.lesson: Spreading exposure reduces dependence on one player; it does not guarantee profit.

missions.title: Price vs expectations
missions.lesson: The analyst estimate is uncertain. A premium or discount is not proof of hype or a guaranteed bargain.

missions.title: Injury risk
missions.lesson: Injury reports affect expected availability. Stops can execute below their trigger and may not fill fully.

missions.title: Season payouts
missions.lesson: Only cutoff ownership earns the game entitlement. Paid dividends are already in cash and must not be counted twice.
